people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
translations.bsb: The LORD answered Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, See, I have made thee as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
